map.输入环境温度与紫外照射强度，估算变色镜片变深（着色）与褪色（回复透明）所需时间，: Enter the ambient temperature and UV irradiance to estimate the time for photochromic lenses to darken and to fade back to clear, showing that higher temperature means faster fading. Used as a reference when buying and wearing photochromic lenses.
map.按紫外强度与温度估变色深浅。: Estimate how dark the lens darkens from UV intensity and temperature.
map.对比基片染与膜层变色。: Compare base-glass tinting with film-layer darkening.
map.：紫外线强（户外）触发银卤化物变深，透光率可由 85% 降到 35%；进室内无紫: Strong UV (outdoors) darkens the silver halide, and transmittance can fall from 85% to 35%; back indoors without UV it clears in minutes.
map.：温度高变色浅（热平衡偏无色），夏天数九比冬天浅；车内因玻璃隔 UV 几乎不变，: High temperature means lighter darkening (the thermal equilibrium leans colorless), so midsummer is lighter than midwinter; in a car the glass blocks UV so it barely changes, which is why an in-car photochromic lens is needed.
map.车内为什么不变？: Why does it not change in the car?
map.汽车玻璃挡大部分 UV，变色片靠 UV 触发，故普通变色在车里不变深，需「车内变: Car glass blocks most UV and photochromic lenses are triggered by UV, so ordinary ones do not darken in the car; you need an in-car variant.
map.反复变色约 2–3 年明显变慢/残留底色，紫外线强地区更短。: After about 2-3 years of repeated darkening it slows noticeably or leaves a residual tint; the life is shorter in areas with strong UV.
